description: This file defines the interface for a test server, including methods for initializing, running, stopping tests, and handling events related to test execution and reporting within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test server with optional parameters such as serializer, disconnect behavior, and test directory watching.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks the responsiveness of the test server.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Watches specified test files for changes.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a location in the test server, specified by a reporter type location.

methods.name: resizeTerminal
methods.description: Resizes the terminal with given columns and rows.

methods.name: runGlobalSetup
methods.description: Runs global setup tasks and returns a report, environment variables, and status.

methods.name: runGlobalTeardown
methods.description: Runs global teardown tasks and returns a report and status.

methods.name: startDevServer
methods.description: Starts a development server and returns a report and status.

methods.name: stopDevServer
methods.description: Stops the development server and returns a report and status.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists files, optionally filtered by projects.

methods.name: listTests
methods.description: Lists tests, optionally filtered by projects, locations, and grep patterns.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs tests with various options such as locations, grep patterns, reporters, and timeouts.

methods.name: findRelatedTestFiles
methods.description: Finds related test files for given files.
